parameters.question: Verify that the answer includes the prior P(D)=0.0001, likelihood P(+|D)=0.99, marginal P(+)=0.99×0.0001+0.02×0.9999=0.020097, and Bayes' theorem yielding P(D|+)=0.000099/0.020097≈0.0049261084.
